source:
@@U03633@@
A genuine virgin birth if there ever was one. Here you are before you're supposed to be.

@@U03635@@
(Softly)

@@U03636@@
Yes, well, there’s another somewhat critical matter: he appears to be a 赫耳玛佛洛狄托斯.

@@U03638@@
All the better! Once incorporated, he'll adapt to the situation.

@@U03639@@
(To 荷蒙库鲁斯.)

@@U03640@@
But of one thing there’s not much doubt. It is in the vast ocean you must make your start! You will start there first on a small scale, happily consuming creatures smaller than you. Then gradually you will grow and, in growing, rise to higher forms and greater accomplishments.

@@U03642@@
How gentle the air is here! The soft, moist smell of growth. How good it feels.

@@U03644@@
I believe you, darling boy! And farther along on this narrow sandy spit it will be even more pleasant, and the atmosphere still more ineffable. Out there we'll have a splendid view of the sea pageant as it floats into sight. Come with me.
translation:
@@U03633@@
真正的处女分娩（如果有的话）。你在你应该在的地方之前就在这里了。

@@U03635@@
（轻声）

@@U03636@@
是的，还有一个有点关键的问题：他似乎是赫耳玛佛洛狄托斯。

@@U03638@@
一切都更好了！一旦合并，他就会适应这种情况。

@@U03639@@
（致荷蒙库鲁斯。）

@@U03640@@
但有一件事没有太多疑问。在浩瀚的海洋中，你必须开始！你将首先从小规模开始，愉快地吃掉比你小的生物。然后你就会逐渐成长，并在成长中达到更高的形式和更大的成就。

@@U03642@@
这里的空气多么柔和啊！柔软湿润的生长气味。感觉多么好啊。

@@U03644@@
我相信你，亲爱的孩子！在这个狭窄的沙嘴上继续前行，会更加令人愉快，气氛也更加难以形容。在那里，当海上盛会漂浮在我们的视野中时，我们将看到壮丽的景色。跟我来吧。
